# Yangjiang Selectedhardware Enterprise Co., Ltd.

> Professional kitchen knife manufacturer and supplier from Yangjiang, China, offering OEM/ODM services for chef knives, knife sets, and specialty cutlery across global markets.

Yangjiang Selectedhardware is a leading hardware manufacturer specializing in kitchen knives and cutlery products. The company serves international markets including North America, South America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Africa with customizable OEM/ODM manufacturing options.

- Kitchen Knives
- Chef Knives
- Knife Sets
- OEM/ODM Services
- Forged Steel
- Stainless Steel
- Serrated Blades
- TPR Handles

- Kitchen Cutlery
- Commercial Knives
- Made-in-China Supplier
- China Manufacturer
- Yangjiang, Guangdong
